== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A pocket world is a contained environment that can be controlled via a central core, which was previously taken from [[Reigan Shen]]. This specific pocket world is relatively small and incomplete compared to larger locations like [[Ghostwater]], with many of its original facilities being unfinished or of little value. Its central control hub is located in a marble cave featuring networks of [[constructs]] and various [[scripts]], though many of these elements were non-functional or only partially completed upon arrival. The interior is devoid of life, [[water]], and sunlight, relying instead on dim [[scripts]] for illumination; the only source of [[aura]] within is [[Northstrider]], who maintains strict control over his presence. The environment can be protected by defensive [[construct]] networks and labyrinthine [[scripts]], though it can also suffer structural damage, such as cracks resulting from a collapsed [[portal]]. It has been utilized as part of strategic plans and can serve as a place to trap individuals.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] possesses a personal pocket world, which can be represented by a warped scar in space. This realm is also shared by [[Mercy]] and Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel. While the dimension features an original entrance, it can be forced open through the use of [[willpower]]. Eventually, [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]] develop a plan that involves utilizing this pocket world.}}
